milestones.name: Three lantern directions, built on the real pipeline, for the owner to pick from
milestones.bar: Each variant could sit on A Short Hike's docks without looking imported, and none looks like a clean commercial low-poly kit (the negative anchor in docs/anchors/references.md)

items.statement: The project imports headless on Godot 4.4 with no errors or warnings from project files
Each of the three lantern variants is at most 1,500 triangles
Each variant uses only the shared materials and the one 512x512 atlas, with every UV triangle inside a region of atlas.json
atlas.json reserves non-overlapping regions for all twelve props, the palette and the detail tiles, and records the set texel density
items.ask: Is every prop in the design's table given atlas space, enough for its parts?

items.statement: The budget and atlas checks would catch a real failure
items.ask: Do the budget and atlas checks count every surface of every MeshInstance3D, nested and multi-surface, and would they fail a 1,501-triangle mesh, a second texture, or a UV outside its region?

items.statement: tools/capture.sh renders a prop's turntable, distances, day/dusk and pixelated views from the preview scene
The three variants differ in kind (shape language, shading and texture treatment), not in colour alone
items.inspect: the three variants side by side, as turntable contact sheets at near and mid distance

items.statement: Each variant holds together from every side: bracket, post, cage, glass and hook, including the underside
items.inspect: each variant's parts from four angles plus the underside, day and dusk, full resolution and pixelated

items.statement: docs/anchors/references.md holds the reference set, with sources, including A Short Hike and a negative anchor
items.ask: Does the set show the hand-made qualities the design names, and is every image from an official press kit or replaced by a link?

items.statement: The owner has picked a direction, recorded in docs/anchors/DIRECTION.md in their words, with the date
items.attended: The owner looks at the three variants' contact sheets and picks one, or a named mix
items.ask: Does DIRECTION.md record a pick the owner made, rather than one the builder chose?

milestones.name: The lantern sways, glows and creaks
milestones.bar: The owner's pick in docs/anchors/DIRECTION.md, finished; a sway as unhurried as the hanging lights in A Short Hike, and a creak that sits under the scene

items.statement: The lantern passes the budget, atlas and scene checks
items.check: tools/check.sh budget lantern && tools/check.sh atlas lantern && tools/check.sh scene lantern

items.statement: The creak loops through its import setting, is a whole number of sway periods long, has no click at the wrap, and peaks at or below -1 dBFS
Each creak starts within 100 ms of a swing extreme, measured from a Movie Maker capture's frames and WAV
The audio checks would catch a real failure
items.ask: Would the audio suite fail a loop with a jump at the wrap, a loop one frame short of the sway period, and creaks a quarter period off the extremes?

items.statement: Two lanterns in one scene start at different phases, with each one's creak still on its own swing
The sway eases like a pendulum at the extremes, the cage, glass and glow move as one, and nothing pops at the loop
items.inspect: a frame sequence over two sway periods, side-on and front-on, including the wrap

items.statement: At dusk the lantern casts a warm pool of light on the ground around it; lit = false turns off glow, light and creak together
items.inspect: the lantern lit and unlit, at dusk and in daylight, near and mid distance

items.statement: The finished lantern matches the owner's pick in shape language, palette and texture treatment
items.inspect: the lantern beside the picked variant from M1, four angles plus underside, full resolution and pixelated

items.statement: The creak's source and licence (CC0 or self-made) and every edit are in docs/CREDITS.md
items.ask: Does the credit name a source and licence that permits use in a commercial game, for every file in the loop?

items.statement: The owner has listened and accepts the creak: it reads as a lantern, the loop isn't noticeable within 30 seconds, and it isn't irritating
items.attended: The owner plays the preview scene with sound, moving the camera towards and away from two lanterns, and records a verdict in docs/evidence
items.ask: Is there a recorded owner verdict on this version of the sound, and does it accept it?

milestones.name: Rope and iron: the dock crane, bollard, rope coil and anchor
milestones.bar: Of a piece with the M2 lantern and the owner's pick; working objects someone made by hand, like the harbour pieces in A Short Hike

items.statement: All four props pass the budget, atlas and scene checks
items.check: tools/check.sh budget dock_crane bollard rope_coil anchor && tools/check.sh atlas dock_crane bollard rope_coil anchor && tools/check.sh scene dock_crane bollard rope_coil anchor

items.statement: The crane reads as a working hand-cranked crane: the rope runs from the winch over the jib tip to the hook
items.inspect: the crane's post, jib, winch and handle, rope and hook, from four angles plus underside, near and mid

items.statement: The crane's silhouette survives the budget: nothing it needs to read at a distance was dropped
items.inspect: the crane at far distance and in the pixelated view, beside the 1.7 m figure

items.statement: The rope coil reads as one spiralled rope, not stacked rings, and the bollard's rope loop sits on it believably
items.inspect: rope_coil from above and at a low angle, and bollard from four angles, near and mid

items.statement: The anchor and its chain read clearly from every side, including where it rests
items.inspect: anchor from four angles plus underside, near and mid

items.statement: The four props and the lantern look like one family: same palette, edge treatment, irregularity and texel density
items.inspect: all five side by side at mid distance, day and dusk, full resolution and pixelated

milestones.name: Nets and wicker: the net rack, lobster pot, buoys and fish basket
milestones.bar: Of a piece with the props before it; nets and wicker as soft and handmade as the fabric and foliage in A Short Hike

items.statement: All four props pass the budget, atlas and scene checks, and the set still uses at most three materials
items.check: tools/check.sh budget net_rack lobster_pot buoys fish_basket && tools/check.sh atlas net_rack lobster_pot buoys fish_basket && tools/check.sh scene net_rack lobster_pot buoys fish_basket

items.statement: The net reads as netting up close and as a soft draped mass from afar, from both sides
items.inspect: net_rack from front, back and side, near, mid and far, full resolution and pixelated

items.statement: The netting doesn't shimmer or crawl as the camera moves at mid distance
items.inspect: a frame sequence of a slow camera dolly past net_rack and lobster_pot at mid distance

items.statement: The lobster pot is see-through between its slats and netting, and the fish basket reads as wicker with fish in it
items.inspect: lobster_pot and fish_basket from four angles plus top, near and mid

items.statement: The buoys read as cork and glass floats tied on one rope, distinct from each other
items.inspect: buoys from four angles, near and mid, day and dusk

items.statement: These four sit in the same family as the props before them
items.inspect: all nine props so far side by side at mid distance, day and dusk, full resolution and pixelated

milestones.name: Crates and barrel, and the whole set as one harbour
milestones.bar: A harbour corner that could be a screenshot from A Short Hike, and plainly not the negative anchor's store kit

items.statement: crate, crate_long and barrel pass the budget, atlas and scene checks
items.check: tools/check.sh budget crate crate_long barrel && tools/check.sh atlas crate crate_long barrel && tools/check.sh scene crate crate_long barrel

items.statement: The manifest lists exactly the twelve props, and every one passes every suite
Crates and the barrel each have their own designed imperfections; no two crates look like copies of one model
items.inspect: crate, crate_long and barrel from four angles plus underside, near and mid

items.statement: crate and crate_long stack on each other with no gap, overlap or flicker
items.inspect: each stacking combination, close up at the joint, from two angles

items.statement: In a harbour vignette with all twelve, the set reads as one hand-made family and nothing looks bought
items.inspect: the vignette at day and dusk, near, mid and far, full resolution and pixelated, beside the anchors

items.statement: No two props share a silhouette at thumbnail size
items.inspect: all twelve as black silhouettes at far distance in one frame

items.statement: The contract in docs/modules/PROPS.md matches what was built
items.ask: Do every scene's path, root, collision, origin and front, the lantern's exports, and the stack height match the contract, and does the manifest record each prop's triangles and footprint?
